gcp._note: router_urn is deliberately left null rather than pointing at a resource: a GCP InterconnectAttachment has no direct network reference of its own -- it attaches to a Cloud Router, whose network you resolve separately (Router.network), per gcp_network_mcp.models.interconnect's own field comment. Cloud Router is not one of this contract's 21 canonical resource types (see NOTES.md), so there is no lossless URN to populate router_urn with; the raw router_self_link is preserved here instead rather than guessing at a stand-in (e.g. pointing at the owning Network or the NCC transit-hub would overclaim a relationship this attachment doesn't directly assert). asn is null for the same reason vlan_id's partner_asn is null: this is a Dedicated (not Partner) attachment, so partner_asn is never populated by GCP, and the Cloud Router's own local ASN -- the only other candidate BGP identity here -- is not exposed on the attachment itself. redacted=true is permanent: no pairing-key-bearing field exists anywhere on this model.
